title: Four-nurse night allocation
summary: Explains how four nurses cover the two theatre parts and manually share Pager when a five-person night drops to four.
changes: When a five-person night drops to four because one nurse is absent, the app shows the four nurses actually present and keeps the remaining theatre positions as rostered.
If a theatre position is vacant, the team explicitly chooses which of the four working nurses fills it; nobody is placed there automatically.
Once two nurses are confirmed in First Part and two in Second Part, the same four nurses manually agree the Pager order for 00:00–07:00.
If the normal Pager nurse is the absent nurse, the original four theatre nurses stay in place and only the Pager order needs to be agreed.
Pager is split equally by real elapsed time: 1h 45m each on ordinary nights and 2h each on the October clock-change night, with current and next cover shown live.
